sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection 
I1 which must performed on a weekly bases as indicated by W1 in the title block.

This compressor serves in compressing air for the governors and breaks of the 
main turbine units 3-9

The first draft 
was initiated by eng. Ashraf Saber, tested by eng. Alsayed Ibrahim El ashmony, 
accepted by general director eng. Abd elghaffar Osman, approved by eng. 
Mohamed Abd elbaset head sector of Aswan Dam (1&2) power stations and 
certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem HPGC inspection and quality control 
general director and MPIS Coordinator..
Technical specifications

Type of 
compressor : E22.5 - 15/Se/Sz - 3 stages - BAUER - Germany

Air 
flowrate (Q) : 850 L/min Max. pressure 
(P) : 40 bar
Revolution (N): 1150 I/min
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.

Wear your safety equipment as helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass .. 
 etc
Disconnect the power supply of the compressor

sections.text: Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set
Compressed air hose for cleaning
Cleaning articles (fluid, rags, ...etc)
Work to be Carried Out

Check function of 
automatic drain valve system and manual valves for OQF 12 AT. 101, 102 and 103. 
Drain the separator water

Check compressor oil sump 
level and Top-up if required

Clean the compressor parts 
by air jet and using rags for the outer surfaces
